entities.summary: One of the world's oldest and most prestigious peer-reviewed medical journals, founded in 1823 by Thomas Wakley. The Lancet pioneered the publication of clinical research, public health investigations, and medical ethics debates, establishing the peer-reviewed journal as the primary vehicle for communicating scientific medical knowledge.
